_readme: Which spine artifacts can be OPERATED. Derived from the scene: each .tscn declares a control widget once and instances it N times, so `counted` is real. `code_built` lists kinds the script preloads and builds at runtime — the kind is known, the number is not, so no number is given. `wired` is the signals the script listens to, which is the proof a control does something. `axes` is the artifact's declared DNA: how many settings it HAS, whether or not any map ever uses them.
